content.short: Proof of Humanity is a secure on-chain verification protocol and registry for people.
content.description: Proof of Humanity is a blockchain-based verification protocol and registry developed by Kleros. Through Proof of Humanity, users submit profiles, attest to the credibility of others, and raise concerns about suspicious accounts. As a decentralized protocol, Proof of Humanity indexes its data as subgraphs within The Graph protocol, enabling on-chain applications to access verified identities. The project emphasizes openness and community participation.
